title: Kid Thomas starts playing at home and quits plantation work
summary: His son Thomas began on instruments left in the house, then walked off a plantation job to play music full time.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, how old was Thomas when he started playing music?
Thomas was young. He started from me. By me having a black band, leave all the instruments here, you know. And he'd be here. Be fooling on him. Playing on him.
Right in this house? Yeah, right in this house.

He started lying there. He's working. He used to work and play music. Well, he left here. There's five minutes to spread. He's holding Ken to feed on the plantation. Throw the hole down.
